name: trial-session-booking
description: Book a free trial class with an available mentor, with time-zone, DST and capacity handling.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test:unit -w apps/api
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U postgres -d trialbooking
